verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents connecting bank and credit card accounts so that transactions are imported automatically and flow into the books for categorization and reconciliation. Payments integration is evidenced only by a bare 'Online Payments' heading, and payroll is not evidenced at all. missing for 10: documented payment-processor feeds into the ledger, any payroll integration, independent or hands-on corroboration of bank-feed reliability

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Zoho Books enhances banking efficiency by enabling your business to connect with bank and credit card accounts. Automatically import transactions, categorise them, and streamline the reconciliation process for swift month-end closing
